title: Chapter 393 Clean
content:
Chapter 393 Clean

Just as he was stunned, a soft touch suddenly came from his right hand.

When I looked closely, the source of the disaster in front of me was actually stretching out my hand to touch my palm, and an expression of enjoyment appeared on my face.

What's going on?

With a move of Lu Daosheng, a ferocious rotten sarcoma appeared in his hand.

This is exactly part of the body of that abyss monster.

What's strange at this moment is that this sarcoma is still trembling slightly, as if it is alive.

It's really tenacious.

Lu Daosheng asked coldly, "Do you know what this is?"

What Lu Daosheng didn't expect was that when he saw the sarcoma in Lu Daosheng's hand at the source of the disaster, he couldn't help but take two steps back. A complex and disgusting expression appeared on his face. He only heard her blurtly say, "This, this is not. Did I pull a dad?”

......

The hall was quiet, and the dilapidated air was filled with an awkward atmosphere.

Yueming, who was standing aside, didn't dare to show his energy at this moment. He didn't dare to look at Lu Daosheng's expression at all. He just lowered his head tightly and his body slowly retreated unconsciously.

The source of the disaster was filled with innocence and confusion. Looking at Lu Daosheng, he was puzzled.

Why is this person so weird? He likes to pick up shit if he has nothing to do.

After a while, two crisp sounds sounded in the hall one after another.

When Lu Daosheng left the hall again, another figure had already appeared behind him, which was the source of the disaster.

Lu Daosheng's face was very bad at this moment.

And Yueming was even more depressed.

He covered his buzzing head with a look of no hope.

No, it has anything to do with me.

On the side, the source of the disaster was the source of the disaster, with his little head lowered and poked his little finger aggrievedly, and tears flashed in his big eyes.

This is the first time someone beat her.

Bad brother.

"Moon Ming."

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly spoke.

"Former, senior?"

Yueming was shocked.

Lu Daosheng looked at Yueming sideways and showed a light smile, but his smile was very creepy.

"I hope you will rot in your stomach for today, otherwise, don't blame me for putting your head in your stomach."

Lu Daosheng's voice was very gentle, but it was heard into Yueming's ears, which made Yueming's face pale and bloodless. He turned his head and looked aside, pretending to be calm and said, "Senior, what are you talking about? I Didn’t you keep venting outside the hall just now?”

Seeing Yueming so sensible, Lu Daosheng nodded with relief and then gave up.

"Where am I going?"

At this time, the source of the disaster could not help but ask.

Lu Daosheng would take her away, which she didn't expect. In her perception, no creature was willing to approach him.

Some are dead.

Lu Daosheng looked back at the source of the disaster. He had no idea about this guy.

But looking at this guy's lonely appearance, Lu Daosheng still felt a little reluctant.

Of course, he took away the source of the disaster, not to do any good deeds, but to use the power of the disaster to make a powerful city.

This guy is a potential stock, but no one taught him to use his power.

"system."

【exist】

"Open the system store."

Suddenly, a screen of dazzling products appeared in Lu Daosheng's sight.

Without exception, these products are all rare treasures, and any one is enough to cause a bloody storm.

But for Lu Daosheng, these are just random choices.

After searching for a little, Lu Daosheng saw a satisfactory product.

As Lu Daosheng's thoughts moved slightly, a collar exuding a soft breath appeared in Lu Daosheng's hands.

The collar is crystal clear, delicate and flawless.

"This thing is called the Ring of Rest. If you carry it on your body, you can suppress the disaster aura emitted from your body."

Lu Daosheng explained that he immediately handed the resting ring to the source of the disaster.

The source of the disaster looked at the collar in front of you, and the like in your eyes was unconcealed.

"Is it for me?"

She said a little in disbelief.

"For you."

Lu Daosheng nodded.

Seeing this, the source of the disaster happily took over the resting ring, but then she showed a distressed expression.

She doesn't know how to wear it.

Lu Daosheng was a little helpless, and then took the resting ring and put it on his neck at the source of the disaster.

In an instant, the disaster aura that continued to emit from the source of the disaster was immediately suppressed, and the originally rich and broken aura around it gradually became thinner.

Really useful!

Yue Ming's eyes were filled with disbelief.

He had never heard of the Ring of Rest, and he could not have thought that there was still a divine object in this world that could suppress disasters.

The foundation of the senior is really unfathomable.

"Hey, senior, don't you know how to thank you for such a good baby?"

Yueming spoke toward the source of the disaster.

Originally, he was still a little afraid of the source of the disaster, but now he found that the source of the disaster was just a child who didn't know anything. Lu Daosheng was by the side, so he had nothing to be afraid of.

At this time, the source of the disaster was still immersed in joy. When he heard Yueming's words, the source of the disaster was stunned and understood Yueming's meaning.

She herself has extremely high intelligence, and now she is just no one teaches her.

Now that she was enlightened, she quickly smiled at Lu Daosheng and said, "Thank you brother."

Looking at the source of the disaster with a bright smile, Lu Daosheng was a little stunned. After a moment of silence, he asked, "Do you have a name?"

The source of the disaster scratched his head and said, "Yes, the Lord of the disaster."

People in the world call her that, so she naturally thinks that this is her name.

When Lu Daosheng heard what the source of the disaster said, he sighed.

If that's the case, give her a name.

After all, I was taking her in.

But, what name is good?

Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment, then looked at Yueming.

Seeing Lu Daosheng's gaze, Yueming immediately understood it. He touched his chin, looked at the source of the disaster, and said, "This guy has always been lonely, no relatives, and it's so dangerous, just call her , , ”

"Just call her Ergou."

"Ergou?"

When she heard this name, she savored it carefully. Although she didn't know what it meant, this was the first time she heard someone give her a name, so she still liked it very much.

Seeing that the source of the disaster was actually ready to accept it happily, Lu Daosheng's mouth twitched slightly.

Lu Daosheng also rewarded Yue Ming Daming with no stinginess to reward him with this good name.

Ignoring Yueming, who was standing aside and covering her butt, Lu Daosheng looked at the source of the disaster and said, "From now on, you will call Jing."

It sounds clean.

When Lu Daosheng chose a name, he liked to choose one word, which was convenient.

"Clean, nice."

I didn't know anything at the source of the disaster, but I nodded happily.

From now on, she has a name, and she can live normally like other creatures.
